name: Adk
summary: a set of guidelines to build with Botpress's Agent Development Kit (ADK) - use these whenever you're tasked with building a feature using the ADK

name: Adk Debugger
summary: Systematic debugging for ADK agents — trace reading, log analysis, common failure diagnosis, and the debug loop.

name: Adk Dev Console
summary: Explains the ADK Dev Console — what each tab shows, how to read Agent Steps, traces, multi-agent dashboard, agent switching, console modes, and other UI features visible at localhost:3001 during adk dev

name: Adk Docs
summary: guidelines for creating, reviewing, updating, and searching ADK documentation - use when users ask about writing, maintaining, or auditing ADK bot docs

name: Adk Evals
summary: Complete reference for writing, running, and iterating on evals (automated conversation tests) for ADK agents. Covers eval file format, all assertion types, CLI usage, and per-primitive testing patterns.

name: Adk Frontend
summary: Guidelines for building frontend applications that integrate with Botpress ADK bots - covering authentication, type generation, client setup, and calling bot actions

name: Adk Integrations
summary: guidelines for discovering, adding, configuring, and using Botpress integrations in ADK projects - use when users ask about connecting services, managing dependencies, or using integration actions
